description: Coarse grey canvas off a Nightmule's pack, rolled tight and trailing a tail. Tents do not sew themselves.
lore: Open it out and it is a tent for one. Cut close, no room in it for a second set of shoulders. The original seams are double-sewn and even, the work of somebody taught properly, with time to do it right. Then, later, in different thread and in a hurry: four more tie-points added down one edge, punched through and whipped round by a hand that had plainly never done it before, so that a flap could be pegged out to the side. Somebody turned a one-man tent into a shelter for two, badly, on the road. The badly-made ties are the ones still holding. That is the whole of what is known about them — that there were two, that one of them could not sew, and that the canvas came down off [[monsters/dark_donkey|an animal that is carrying nothing at all now]] and has not been pitched in a very long time.
gm_notes: The person record of the mule's kit. Two travellers, no names, one competent and one not; the amateur's work outlasted the professional's. Deliberately unresolvable.
